name: mirage
text: v1.0.8 is out. Engine > APIs now has a light per API (neon green = working, amber = a problem: tap the card for the error, grey = off), a Test now button and a Try again button (the engine forgives only that API on its next scan; no scan cancelled). Also in: cross-exchange hedges (Novig one side, Kalshi/SX the other) are recorded as paper only in a journal for study; they don't show on the Live board yet, and nothing is ordered on Kalshi or SX. Link: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.8
